g.text: Four NoSQL families, four query shapes
Each one exists because a particular access pattern was awkward in a relational table.
One lookup, by a key you
Relational → model the data, then query it any way you like
NoSQL → know the queries, then model the data to serve them
Get the access patterns wrong and a rewrite is the only fix.
'Schemaless' means schema-on-read: the structure still exists,
it just lives in your application instead of the database.
Nobody removed the schema. They moved who enforces it.
